subject: How to append_row for scalar in model block?

messages.author: ba47d4626a81b156
messages.subject: How to append_row for scalar in model block?
parts:
Dear Stan users, 

My question may seem a little bit stupid. I want to create a vector in the model block. For example, theta and sigma are my parameters (real), and I want to combine theta and sigma to be a new vector (mu, sigma).  It seems that append_row and append_col can only combine vectors and matrices. Is there a way to combine scalar? like cbind() or rbind() does in R? 

Thanks,

Chubing

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] How to append_row for scalar in model block?
parts:
If you only have two parameters, then it's easy.

...
model {
  vector[2] thetas;
  theta[1] <- theta;
  theta[2] <- sigma;
  ...
}

For more help, you'll need to be more specific. Stan's types aren't meant to be dynamically resized. (Bob, let me know if either that isn't true or if there's a better way to state that.)




Daniel

I tried: 
...
parameter{
real<lower=0> theta[n];
real<lower=0> sigma[n];
...
} 

model{
...
vector[n] Y[2]
for (i in 1:n){
Y[1]<-theta[i];
Y[2]<-sigma[i]
...
}


Thanks,

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] How to append_row for scalar in model block?
parts:
You can't assign arrays, like theta, to vectors like Y[1].

So you just want to bind them together, so what you want is
this:

parameters {
row_vector[N] a;
row_vector[N] b;
}
transformed parameters {
matrix[2, N] ab;
ab <- append_row(a, b);
}

You can declare ab as being matrix[N, 2] if you
declare a and b as vector and use append_col.

- Bob
